commits.message:
fix(render): a piece opening a line past a dropped blank keeps its padding (candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.pe6)

The blank filter ran before padding read a piece's index, so when a cell's left
padding split off as a blank piece, the piece that actually opened the line
counted as first and went unpadded. Two comments this change made false now say
what happens.

fix(render): a wrapped cell starts on the line left open, and its lines keep their padding (candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.pe6)

A short cell ahead of a wrapped one stood alone on a row, because the first
piece was as wide as a whole line. On an open doctor report that spent a blank
row on each row it hit, and height is what wrapping costs. The first piece now
wraps from the cells already on the line, measured through the draw, and a
first word that doesn't fit moves to the next line whole.

A piece that opens a line wears the cell's padding, so a continuation doesn't
sit flush against the cap. The widest-glyph floor had two spellings and now has
one name.

A wrapped cell's pending placeholder still draws one line
(candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.1gq); the memory says so.

fix(render): a cell divides only when it overflows as drawn, and loses no text (candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.pe6)

A full-width space hanging at a break lost text: rich-js crops it in half at
the edge, so the drawn line was no slice of the text and its search missed. The
search now looks for a line's content, less the whitespace hanging off it.

Every cell was charged a painted cell's caps, so an unpainted spacer came up
short of the edge and a cell that fit broke across lines. Whether a cell
divides is now measured through the draw; a piece still wraps at the painted
line, so it fits however it is painted.

A justified cell's padding no longer spends rows on nothing, and the wrap draws
plain text, which keeps a cell's styles and justification out of it.

fix(render): a cell wider than its line wraps across lines (candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.pe6)

A row breaks only between strip items, so one long cell had nowhere to go.
Claude Code draws each statusline line truncated, so the line lost its right
end where the bar could not see it. On a long branch that was the git cell's
`▸`, and on a doctor row the reason it was opened to read.

The row seam now divides any item wider than a line into items that fit, at
the breaks rich-js's own word wrap chooses. Nothing is cut. `paged: false` now
wraps as its docs have always said, with no picker logic, and `autoWrap: false`
keeps each row one unbounded line.

The ticket offered shortening or a warning. A cut loses content nobody chose
to lose: controls sit at both ends of a cell and between them. A warning would
flip on every resize of a terminal nobody has to fix.

Wrapping spends height. Closed bars do not change from width 80 up. Two costs
are accepted and filed: an open doctor report can now pass the terminal's
height at sizes where it used to fit (brandon-unfiled-3248.9yxg), and the tmux
status line, which silently shows five rows, loses more of a narrow pane's bar
(brandon-unfiled-3248.vvdp). `cellBreaks` on the render event and the feed
summary says how often this happens.

refactor(test): tests read the Frame, and nothing decodes rendered ANSI (candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.bzq) (#554)

* refactor(test): tests read the Frame, and nothing decodes rendered ANSI (candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.bzq)

The epic's last slice. A reader outside src now holds the Frame a draw
returned, so ANSI is written once, for terminals, and never read back.

test/helpers/ansi.ts is gone, with the SGR state machines in
test/helpers/seams.ts and proto-looks/build.mjs and about twenty local
decoders. Colour reads Run.fg, Run.bg and attrs. renderDsl, buildLineStrip
and toCell leave src, since only tests called them, and drawPayload moves
to a test helper. check's outcome holds the Frame; encoding sits at what
prints or weighs it.

Comparing draws is by value on rows, because two draws are two objects and
each frame carries its own wall-clock moment. A byte test keeps ansiOf;
only the files that pin an encoder hold escapes.

* fix(test): tests name what they pin, and comments name who binds (candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.bzq)

Review of the Frame migration. A failed click's error on Claude Code's bar is pinned in a session no lane follows, since a followed session's render answers the handoff row. A render's fit to its size is pinned where the Frame is held. truecolorOf refuses a colour the terminal owns, and runAt and backgroundsOf replace local copies. Comments that said drawDsl binds a payload, settles a selection or resolves an omitted one now name the view and the bind.

* fix(test): draws compare by rows, and a reader finds the run under its text (candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.bzq)

Tests that compared draws through the encoder now compare rows, as the testing memory says. runUnder matches a needle exactly where a search of spaceless characters matched across gaps. A failed click's error on Claude Code's bar is pinned with the statusline lane followed. The real client's literals read what it printed, rather than one draw equalling another. The fit test uses a fixed bar, since a cell wider than the width cannot wrap and a branch name is one.

## [1.178.0](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.177.2...v1.178.0) (2026-11-01)

### Features

* **daemon:** a one-shot reader asks for the Frame, scripts and site decode nothing (candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.dnr) ([#553](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/553)) ([f41741e](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/f41741ee3454a3f31d5d7a2e4dc195a17c786319))

gitaculous already shows the location, so the default layout drops directory

The default identity row and five bundled presets (compact, verbose, zen,
git, dense) still placed `directory` beside `gitaculous`, which now draws
the checkout path itself. Every default user saw the path twice. The
directory segment stays defined in the library; only its placement goes.

Tests that read the bundled layout now name a segment the bar still places,
and the doc fence shows the one path it renders.

Known consequence: `zen` now holds only `context`, so it no longer shows
where you are. Its comment still describes the old intent.

feat(site): the live bar's font size is a control, and starts larger
